author: root Codex personal mechanism design and conditional proof
positive_design: Absolute destination-permission frontiers bound the complete shared source obligation, including old buffered unprepared data; use the maximal safe endpoint as a feasibility bound, not as a fastest policy.

state.s: common delivered source cursor before the next physical source AR; previous physical source envelopes settled
state.F_i: end of a continuous usable retained own-WRITE region covering every pending write head through this endpoint
state.Q_i: actual private payload capacity exclusively reserved for this cohort, including existing buffered tails; shared upstream spill is not multiplied
state.e: absolute end of the next immutable physical source child

rule.candidate_end: e_max = min(original accepted source request end, source READ certificate ends of all recipients, AXI length/page endpoint, job endpoint, min_i(F_i + Q_i))
rule.admission: s < e <= e_max; fix all source AR fields before first VALID; do not extend the original logical source request
rule.resident_write: Each physical WRITE child is wholly resident and within its own retained WRITE coverage, independently of peer prefix child count; all real W/B and original logical completion remain accounted.

assumptions: Frozen cohort with every own source READ validated for the same physical data and compatible attributes.
Ordered source delivery with per-consumer acceptance accounting; only own authorized pending prefixes drain, eventual fair real W/B service.
No extra capacity obligations or descriptor reuse in reserved Q_i; grant validity and certificate ownership survive actual writes/B.
Initial stable successful mappings; permanent fault/remap/revocation needs an explicit recovery contract, not this proof.
Once this physical source RLAST is consumed, tail PTW can eventually return. This abstracts the shared return dependency; it is not a production timing model.

proof.sufficient: While a received word lies in an authorized pending prefix, finite private buffering can stall temporarily but that prefix can drain without any next-page PTW. Once source progress exceeds F_i, all unprepared words for recipient i through e number at most max(0,e-F_i) <= Q_i. Thus they fit without waiting for that blocked PTW, allowing the source RLAST to retire. After that the remaining translation dependency can be served.
proof.necessary_within_contract: If e > F_k + Q_k for any k, drain every authorized prefix then deliver exactly Q_k unprepared words. The next source word cannot enter private storage; hold its R ahead of the needed PTE until source RLAST. This is a reachable dependency cycle in this restricted return contract. Extra VC, spill, recipient detachment or source splitting changes the contract and its costs.
proof.maximality_scope: Largest safe endpoint against this stated adverse ordering under these assumptions; not throughput optimality or an all-system liveness theorem.

decisive_pair.initial: s0, F_A5/F_B6, Q_A3/Q_B3, original source N8
decisive_pair.legal: e8 admits one physical shared source envelope with no full-WRITE sponsor; suffix lengths3/2 fit
decisive_pair.neighbor: e9 violates A capacity: r8,w_A5 with full A tail3 and one source word outstanding; tail-PTE blocked behind source RLAST
decisive_pair.carried_state: s7,F_A5,Q_A3 already contains unprepared tail2; e_max8, so only one more source word is safe. Reusing Q3 as entirely free for the new child would overcommit.
decisive_pair.execution: Hand derivation only this stage; the initial single-flow N8/N9 pair was already executed in stage84, unchanged and not rerun.

cost_decision: Maximum safe endpoint may save one source AR but can delay tail PTW or complete ACK. Compare common-prefix shared splitting and one-full sponsor at identical retained permission/result and payload budgets; do not assume full preparation requires every recipient to be fully prepared.
actual_platform_gate: Stage84 source proof: independent lengths only decouple_rw1/deburst0; production RAW_COUPLING_AVAIL0; future enabling coupler must supply actual multi-AW release. Native access_ok handshake, owned PA/cookie/result routing, original job failure and revocation handling remain required new interfaces.
innovation_condition: If a complete same-budget ordinary control realizes the same admissible action and cost, this rule is a safety characterization/component rather than an independent performance contribution. If the contract enables a distinct useful action or provable resource/latency bound beyond a named complete control and closest exact prior, that narrow capability can support a contribution. Absence from inspected passages alone is not proof of firstness.
implementation: No new RTL, Linux, simulator or build authored or executed.
